name: Rabsaris
groups: 1. A title of an Assyrian officer

definition.text: Chief of the Heads, one of the three officers whom Sennacherib sent from Lachish with a threatening message to Jerusalem (2 Kings 18:17; Jer. 39:3, 13).

lemmas.gloss: Nergal-Sharetser, the name of two Babylonians
